adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, a method `feed_key` is introduced that builds a Redis-style cache key (`"feed-modified:..."`), but that method is never called anywhere in the diff, and there is no code that reads/writes this key or uses it to perform conditional HTTP requests. Separately, `poll_feed` always executes `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` on each run, so there is no implemented short-circuit based on a stored last-modified/etag value in this change. While the reviewer’s mention of “intended conditional-GET/Last-Modified” is an inference, the core issue—unused/dead `feed_key` and no caching to avoid repeated full downloads—is directly verifiable in the diff.
